why: Intel Macs are no longer supported: the macOS SSH helper is built for Apple silicon only and bundled as helper/darwin-arm64 instead of helper/darwin-universal. Debug builds, which made every recording, already built it for arm64 only, so the bytes, size and digest the recordings observed are what the renamed file holds; only the bundled path the app observes (before an upload, and the file identity some SSH and herdr launches check) changed.
